mapper.insert: insert into profile (description, user_id, nickname) values (#{description}, #{userId}, #{nickname});
mapper.select: select id, description, user_id as userId, nickname from profile where id = #{id};
select p.id as id, description, user_id as userId, nickname from profile p join user u on p.user_id = u.id where user_id = #{userId};

nickname = #{nickname},
